items.title: Warren Buffett’s Berkshire Has Sold 84% of One Bank Stock in Six Months. Only 1.15 Million Shares Are Left
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway's new 13F shows 1,150,000 Capital One shares on September 30, down from 7,150,000 on March 31.

items.title: How Online Banking Outages At Capital One Financial (COF) Have Changed Its Investment Story
items.summary: Capital One Financial declared past quarterly dividends on several preferred series and affirmed a US$0.80 common dividend, with all payments scheduled for December 1, 2026, to shareholders of record on November 16, 2026. The combination of steady preferred and common dividends with recent online banking outages highlights the tension between returning capital and maintaining resilient technology infrastructure at Capital One Financial. items.title: Why Are US Banks Reporting Outages? JPMorgan Rules Out Cyberattack, Blames Software Bug
items.summary: According to DownDetector, in addition to JPMorgan, service disruptions were also reported at Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Capital One Financial, and U.S. Bancorp.

items.title: Bank outage reports spike: JPMorgan says issues are resolved, blames internal software bug for transaction delays
items.summary: Reports of bank app outages surged on Monday, sparking widespread alarm days after last week's major Microsoft Outlook outage.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.

items.title: Berkshire trims Bank of America, Capital One stakes, adds to Delta investment
items.summary: Investment.com -- Berkshire Hathaway reshuffled its equity portfolio in the third quarter, cutting its exposure to Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its investment in Delta Air Lines and building a new position in Italian technology company Bending Spoons, a regulatory filing showed on Monday.

items.title: What to Know About the Banking Service Outages Impacting Thousands of Customers
items.summary: Thousands of customers at multiple major U.S. banks are reporting problems afterJPMorgan Chase said it was experiencing a technical issue.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
items.summary: According to the company’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, the firm’s overall equity portfolio stood at roughly $304 billion across about 30 positions as of the end of the quarter.
